target: Teach another learner to reason about symbolic reasoning using a rule-based inference trace. Have a separate evaluator hold unseen items and answer keys.

competency.title: Teach symbolic reasoning — independent holdout
competency.outcome: Teach another learner to reason about symbolic reasoning using a rule-based inference trace. Have a separate evaluator hold unseen items and answer keys.
competency.practice_task: Produce a lesson, coached exercise and blind learner transfer test grounded in a rule-based inference trace.
competency.setting_constraint: Have a separate evaluator hold unseen items and answer keys.
required_evidence: a lesson, coached exercise and blind learner transfer test
Include item-set hash, evaluator identity and aggregate verdict only.
Report valid conclusions and contradiction rate with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: skipping an unstated premise.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of symbolic reasoning.
Practice: the learner succeeds on a new case without the answer key.
Measurement: report valid conclusions and contradiction rate against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for skipping an unstated premise; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
